identity_reason: it is a layout that places Navbar, Sidebar, BottomNav and the content, so every visible part comes from those
concept: The frame of an app: header on top, a sidebar beside the content when wide, a bottom bar instead when narrow, and a skip link.

root.why: the shell measures its own width so it works in a stage as well as a window

grid.why: one column when narrow with the areas stacked in reading order

hasSide.why: with a sidebar the grid adds its column once the shell is wide enough

hasAside.why: with an aside the grid adds a third column on a very wide shell

header.why: the header stays at the top while the content scrolls

side.why: the sidebar is hidden when narrow and sticks beside the content when wide

main.why: the main landmark takes focus from the skip link without a ring of its own

aside.why: the aside drops under the content when narrow and sticks beside it when wide

bottom.why: the bottom bar floats at the foot when narrow and hides once the sidebar shows

skip.why: the skip link is the first stop and appears only while it has focus

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the part is reached by keyboard
